messages:
Maya Chan: hi folks — i'm maya, starting today on infra. bringing a batch of vegan scones to the kitchen at 11:30 if anyone fancies one 36a
Noah Park: nice!! will swing by with a travel mug :coffee: see you 11:35
Samira K.: vegan scones?? count me in. what flavor?
Maya Chan: cinnamon-maple and a lemon-poppyseed option in the green container (labelled). left a little sticky note with ingredients.
DevBot: Reminder: New hire check-in 14:00 in #people-ops. (automated)
Lina R.: welcome @Maya Chan! if you're into tiny office plants i maintain a "desk swap" shelf — can pair you with a low-maintenance snake plant.
Tom B.: welcome aboard. FYI fridge etiquette: if it's not labelled it becomes community property after 48h 602 (not that i'm speaking from experience...)
Tamika S.: Maya! i'm on building security and can sort your badge setup after you snag a scone. also happy to show you the quiet phone room.
Noah Park: lunchtime: casual boardgame meetup in the lounge. new hires usually show up — great way to meet people without the awkward coffee chat.
Samira K.: posting the quick scone recipe for anyone who asks: `2 cups flour, 1/3 cup sugar, 1 tbsp baking powder, 1/2 cup coconut oil, 3/4 cup almond milk` — fold in zest or cinnamon as desired.
Maya Chan: thanks everyone! excited to be here. i'll hang around near the kitchen after 11:30 and then join the boardgames if anyone wants to team up :)
thread_excerpt: Maya Chan brings vegan scones, folks coordinate meetups, orientation reminder, plant buddy offer, badge help offered
